# scamp_managed_app (Resource)

Manages a One-Click App: GitLab or Docker with Portainer on its own server, installed and kept up to date by ServersCamp. The app has its own name under apps.scamp.pro with a certificate we renew. Without a public address it is reached from the private network and over VPN Gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_managed_app" "gitlab" {
  app    = "gitlab"
  name   = "git"
  plan   = "basic-8g-dedicated"
  public = false # reached over VPN Gateway only
}

output "gitlab_url" {
  value = scamp_managed_app.gitlab.url
}

output "gitlab_ssh" {
  value = "ssh ${scamp_managed_app.gitlab.ssh_user}@${scamp_managed_app.gitlab.private_ip}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Which app: gitlab or docker. Changing it replaces the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the app: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. It is the start of the address, NAME-xxxxxx.APP.apps.scamp.pro. Changing it replaces the app.
- `plan` (String) Server plan, e.g. basic-8g-dedicated. Apps run on dedicated Basic plans; GitLab needs 8 GB or more. Changing it replaces the app.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network, attached to a router. Without it the account's default network. Changing it replaces the app.
- `maintenance` (String) App updates: manual (we tell you, you start them) or off. Default manual. Changing it replaces the app.
- `public` (Boolean) Public IPv4 and IPv6, default true. Off: the app's name points at its private address and it is reached from the private network and over VPN Gateway. Changed in place; turned on again it gets a new address.
- `security_group_id` (String) UUID of a security group. Without it a new group is made with SSH, HTTP and HTTPS open. Changing it replaces the app.
- `ssh_key_id` (Number) ID of an SSH key saved in the account, for root over SSH. Changing it replaces the app.

### Read-Only

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) The administrator's first password. Once it is changed in the app this one stops working; the state keeps the first one.
- `admin_user` (String) The app's administrator.
- `hostname` (String) The app's name, NAME-xxxxxx.APP.apps.scamp.pro.
- `id` (String) The app's id.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4, empty when public is off.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6, empty when public is off.
- `private_ip` (String) The server's address in its network: SSH and the app over VPN Gateway.
- `ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) The password of ssh_user, as the server was made with it.
- `ssh_user` (String) The server's user for SSH, with sudo.
- `state` (String) creating, installing, running, failed or deleting.
- `url` (String) https:// address of the app.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the app's server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_managed_app.gitlab 4e5b1e18-9802-4d1a-962b-d03a32f5b5d5
```
